image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of an adult bison's head and shoulder hump, with a portion of a calf visible in the bottom right corner. The adult bison has dark, shaggy fur on its head and forequarters, a prominent horn, and a wet nose. The background is blurred green grass.

The visible eye is dark and clearly defined.
